# lmw profile show

Show a profile: headline, about, experience, education, skills

```
lmw profile show PROFILE [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  lmw profile show ada-lovelace
  lmw profile show https://www.linkedin.com/in/ada-lovelace/ --json
```
